features.name: Six-tier classification
features.description: Every email is filed into one of six priority tiers, from 1 - ME (health, security) down to 6 - Low Priority (promotions, social), each with its own color.
features.notes: Tiers + colors defined in Tools/config.json: 1-ME (red), 2-Inner Circle (orange), 3-Life Admin (yellow), 4-Active Projects (blue), 5-Interests (purple), 6-Low Priority (gray)

features.name: Sender & subject rules
features.description: Mail is matched on sender domain and subject keywords, so it routes to the right tier automatically with no AI cost.
features.notes: config.json carries ~104 sender rules + ~81 subject keywords across 31 sub-labels

features.name: Triage for the unsorted
features.description: Anything the rules can't confidently place gets a Triage label and is surfaced for review instead of being lost in the inbox.
features.notes: _Triage label (Apps Script) / 0 - Triage (extension); stale unsorted mail auto-triaged after 30 days

features.name: Skip-the-inbox auto-archive
features.description: Once an email is tiered it is archived out of the inbox, so the inbox only ever holds the genuinely unsorted.
features.notes: moveToArchive() in Apps Script; removeLabelIds:['INBOX'] in generated Gmail filters

features.name: One-click classify
features.description: Open the EasyFlow side panel inside Gmail and sort your inbox into tiers with a single command.
features.notes: sidepanel chat UI; commands like classify / triage / analyze

features.name: Works in Chrome and Edge
features.description: The same extension runs in both Chrome and Microsoft Edge, with sign-in handled correctly on each browser.
features.notes: getAuthToken on Chrome, launchWebAuthFlow fallback on Edge — separate OAuth clients

features.name: Subscription / unsubscribe manager
features.description: Find noisy newsletter and promotional senders and ban or keep them from a clear two-panel view.
features.notes: v1.2.1 redesigned Gmail Subscriptions: two-panel Ban/Keep, Diagnostics moved out

features.name: Label cleanup & migration
features.description: Retire or delete old labels and move their messages into the new tier structure — no manual drag-and-drop.
features.notes: cleanup retires to _Retired/<name> or deletes; migrate batch-moves messages (up to 5,000 per source) to tier labels

features.name: Wildcard label operations
features.description: Operate on whole groups of labels at once using patterns like '2*' or 'Upd*'.
features.notes: resolveWildcardLabels() resolves the pattern against the live label list

features.name: 10-language interface
features.description: The whole UI is available in ten languages so the tool feels native to its user.
features.notes: EN, ZH-CN, FR, DE, JA, KO, PT-BR, ES, HI, RU — manual translations only (no machine translation)

features.name: Guided onboarding
features.description: A first-run walkthrough handles sign-in, picks a starter template, and explains the tier model.
features.notes: onboarding/onboarding.js + guide-i18n.js; starter templates e.g. 'Work + Personal'

features.name: AI classifies the grey-area mail
features.description: Emails the plain rules can't place are read by an AI — sender, subject, and snippet only — which suggests the best tier with a confidence score.
features.notes: aiTriageBatch(): up to 200 messages; only accepts a label that exists in the user's tier tree

features.name: Pick your own AI provider
features.description: Choose Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or a local Ollama model — you supply your own key, so there is no per-email cost to EasyFlow.
features.notes: Single-provider model; keys stored in chrome.storage.local; email bodies never sent — metadata + snippet only

features.name: Conversational assistant
features.description: Ask the side-panel assistant about your tiers and what to do next; it answers in your chosen language.
features.notes: callProvider() routes chat to the configured provider; responses localized via LOCALE_TO_LANGUAGE

features.name: 24/7 Google Apps Script classifier
features.description: EasyFlow generates a Google Apps Script that runs on Google's servers and sorts new mail every 15 minutes — even with your PC and browser switched off.
features.notes: classifyNewEmails (15-min trigger) + triageStaleInbox (daily 1 AM) via setupTriggers()

features.name: Server-side Gmail filters
features.description: EasyFlow can write native Gmail filters from your tier rules, so Gmail itself auto-labels and files mail with zero software running.
features.notes: create_filters.py batches senders/subjects into OR queries; add label + skip inbox

features.name: Colored label tree, built for you
features.description: The full tier label hierarchy is created in Gmail with the right colors in one pass.
features.notes: create_gmail_labels.py uses Gmail's fixed color palette; nested via '/' separator

features.name: One-click Apps Script deploy
features.description: Push the generated classifier straight into your Apps Script project from the dashboard instead of copy-pasting.
features.notes: /api/deploy/auto via Apps Script API — needs a saved script ID + script.projects token; manual copy-paste always available as fallback

features.name: Visual tier designer
features.description: Design and reorder the whole tier and sub-label tree in a local web dashboard, then save it as your live configuration.
features.notes: Flask dashboard /designer + /configure at http://localhost:8550

features.name: Filter & migration preview
features.description: See exactly which filters will be created and which messages will move before anything touches your inbox.
features.notes: /api/filters/preview and /api/migrate/scan return counts before any change

features.name: Safe, backed-up config
features.description: Every save backs up the previous configuration first, so a bad edit is never destructive.
features.notes: save_config() writes config.json.bak before overwriting

features.name: Diagnostic log export
features.description: When something misbehaves, export a merged diagnostic log to share for support.
features.notes: 1000-entry rolling log in chrome.storage.local; merged service-worker + page timeline; level filter info/warn/all/debug

features.name: Free gift for family & friends
features.description: EasyFlow's core is, and stays, free — it began as a no-cost tool for the people around its author.
features.notes: Registry family_notes: standalone desktop tool, gift for family/friends

features.name: Chrome Web Store / Edge listing
features.description: Public listings are prepared and submitted to the Chrome Web Store and Microsoft Edge Add-ons.
features.notes: Submitted; CASA security verification is the 6-14 week critical path (CWS rejection handled 2026-04-14)

features.name: Outlook support
features.description: The same tier engine will sort Outlook / Microsoft 365 mail via a dual-provider design.
features.notes: Microsoft Graph + MS OAuth2/PKCE; ~80% code reuse; 6-phase plan, after Gmail perfection

features.name: Paid tiers (Free / Pro / Premium)
features.description: Optional paid tiers add power features on top of the free core, with a Gmail-anchored 30-day trial.
features.notes: Monetization v2 LOCKED 2026-04-16: Free / Pro $39 / Premium $79; Cloudflare Workers+KV backend; deferred to v1.3+
